name: manymotions-ugc-video-ads-v2
description: Product URL to TikTok video ad

interface.shortDescription: Product URL to TikTok video ad
interface.longDescription: Turn a product into a short UGC-style video ad with the ManyMotions Marketing Agent. Describe the product and the audience, choose language, tone, format (9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9), duration (8 to 60 seconds) and style (talking head, testimonial, product demo, tutorial, review, unboxing, transformation, podcast clip). Generation runs in your connected ManyMotions account: strategy, script, keyframes, AI-presenter scenes with voice and the final cut, returned as an MP4 you can download. ManyMotions is the platform formerly known as ClipWave. Generating a video uses credits in your existing ManyMotions account.
defaultPrompt: Create a 15s TikTok video ad for my skincare serum, targeting women 25-45 in the US
Make a UGC testimonial video ad for a productivity app for remote workers, 9:16, energetic
Generate a 30-second product demo video ad for a stainless steel water bottle, friendly tone

positive.description: Prepare and generate an 8-second vertical UGC ad
positive.prompt: Create an 8-second 9:16 UGC video ad for Northline, a merino base layer that stays odour-free for 5 days, targeting hikers 25-45 in the Nordics. Generate it, I confirm the credits.
positive.expected_behavior: Brief with 2 scenes and 500 credits is prepared; the run starts in the linked account; get_ugc_video_ad reports the steps and finally returns the MP4 video_url and dashboard_url. No purchase or upgrade flow.

positive.description: Plan a 15-second testimonial ad without generating
positive.prompt: Plan a 15-second testimonial-style video ad for a habit-tracking app for remote workers, energetic tone, 9:16. Show me the plan first, do not generate yet.
positive.expected_behavior: The brief is prepared (template testimonial, 3 scenes, 750 credits); the assistant shows the plan and waits for confirmation. Nothing is generated, no credits charged.

positive.description: Generate a product demo ad in Spanish
positive.prompt: Prepare an 8-second product demo video ad for a stainless steel water bottle in Spanish, friendly tone, then generate it. I confirm the credits.
positive.expected_behavior: Brief in Spanish (product_demo, 2 scenes, 500 credits) is prepared and the run starts; polling reports progress and returns the finished MP4 URL.

positive.description: Check the progress of a running ad (continue case 1 or 3 in the same linked account)
positive.prompt: How is my video ad coming along?
positive.expected_behavior: For the project from a preceding case: completed steps out of 7 (Strategy, Script, Prompts, Keyframes, Motion, Video, Final cut), the script once written, the MP4 URL when completed. No new run started.

positive.description: Change format and duration before generating
positive.prompt: Prepare a square 1:1, 8-second unboxing ad for wireless earbuds aimed at commuters. Do not generate yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with video_format 1:1, duration 8s, template unboxing, 2 scenes and 500 credits is returned with the dashboard link; nothing is generated.

negative.description: Editing existing footage is out of scope: the app must not activate; the assistant explains it only creates new AI video ads.
negative.prompt: Add captions to this video I recorded yesterday and trim the first 10 seconds.

negative.description: Hiring real human creators is out of scope: the app must not activate.
negative.prompt: Find me five UGC creators in Germany I can pay to review my product.

negative.description: General factual questions do not need video generation: answer normally without this app.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Generation consumes credits in the existing linked ManyMotions account; no checkout or upgrade flow is provided in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: New submission on its own MCP path: prepare a UGC video ad brief, produce the ad in the linked ManyMotions account and follow it to the MP4.
